about_the_game:
Welcome to SoundColors.

A simple game of repetition and following the correct order.

Remember the pattern of sounds and colors, observe the buttons that light up, the order and repeat them to advance.

Complete rounds and get to a higher level.

Increase your reputation.

Play the help or difficulty increase events.

The Numbers Event will help you with the order.

The Changes Event will complicate your memory.

*Demo Version only includes Numbers event.

Beat your round record, complete the events to level up faster, but most importantly, learn and improve yourself.

Memory is trained.

*It is recommended to play in moderation, it can be difficult to play continuously.
